01 — The way we travel

Less itinerary. More feeling.

The best journeys leave room for the unexpected.

Bitcoin Nomads is a community that hikes, camps and travels across Africa, starting with Kenya. On every route we share what we know about Bitcoin, so more people can build financial security and literacy. You don’t need to own Bitcoin to travel with us.
